ES.why: Stocks leapt on the Democratic sweep (gridlock read as calmer policy) and falling oil; funds sit mid-range (35th pct), so no crowding against it.
ES.risk: Oil spikes again on Iran headlines or yields jump on a hot jobs/ISM read.

NQ.why: Nasdaq rallied with the market, but AI/data-centre stocks face new regulation fears and funds are crowded long (94th pct).
NQ.risk: Tech leads a clean follow-through higher, or AI names drop and trigger a crowded-long unwind.

YM.why: The Dow led with its best day of 2026 (~1,500 pts) on the midterm result and lower oil; broad, value-heavy buying.
YM.risk: A sharp oil rebound or a hawkish Fed repricing of the December hike.

RTY.why: Lower yields, cheaper oil and a domestic-growth risk-on tone favour small caps; exact close not confirmed.
RTY.risk: Yields climb back toward recent highs.

NKD.why: Nikkei fell 3% Wednesday as AI stocks were hit by US data-centre scrutiny; Wall St rally helps, but chip-heavy index and a firmer yen cut against it.
NKD.risk: Japanese chip stocks bounce hard with US futures, or the AI selloff deepens.

6E.why: The dollar slipped after the election and EUR/USD rose ~0.3% as US yields eased.
6E.risk: US data beat lifts Fed-hike odds and the dollar.

6J.why: Dollar and US yields fell while the BOJ is seen hiking in December; funds are neutral (74th pct), so room either way.
6J.risk: Risk-on carry trades weaken the yen again, or US yields rebound.

6B.why: Pound only edged up with the softer dollar; no clear UK-specific driver found.
6B.risk: A BoE surprise or a broad dollar move.

6A.why: RBA hiked to 4.85% Tuesday and the risk-on mood plus softer dollar lifted AUD (~0.70).
6A.risk: Risk-off reversal or a dollar rebound.

ZN.why: Treasuries rallied (10y ~4.9%, down ~3bp) as gridlock limits deficit spending and oil fell, easing inflation fears.
ZN.risk: Strong jobs data push December Fed-hike odds (~77%) higher.

GC.why: Weaker dollar helps gold, but falling oil eases inflation fears and risk-on lowers safe-haven demand; reports conflict.
GC.risk: A clear break in the dollar or a new Iran flare-up.

CL.why: Oil tumbled on hopes US-Iran peace talks end the war; but funds are already near-crowded short (13th pct), limiting downside follow-through.
CL.risk: Talks stall or new strikes revive the war premium; short squeeze risk.
